entities.summary: Mexican Empire, a political institution in Costa Rica during Independence and the Coffee Republic (1821–1838). Grew from Marginal Colony within Guatemala Captaincy. Led to the emergence of Independence and Federation Era and First Coffee Exports to Britain 1843.
